definitions: To make a short, loud, explosive cry, as a dog or fox.
To speak in a loud, abrupt, or angry tone.
To make a sound resembling a bark.
To scrape skin off a part of the body by accidentally hitting it against something hard.
To remove the bark from a tree.
examples: The dog started to bark loudly.
He would bark orders at his subordinates.
The gun barked in the distance.
I barked my shin on the coffee table.
They had to bark the logs before processing them.
